facts.text: The hotel is located in Nashville's Music Row, minutes from The Gulch and Downtown Nashville.
facts.excerpt: Located in the heart of Nashville’s Music Row, minutes from The Gulch and Downtown Nashville

facts.text: The hotel is steps away from Vanderbilt University and the Gulch neighborhood.
facts.excerpt: steps away from Vanderbilt University and the trendy Gulch neighborhood

facts.text: The signature two-chamber rooms have separate areas for sleeping and living, divided by a privacy partition.
facts.excerpt: Our signature two-chamber hotel rooms in downtown Nashville come with designated areas for sleeping and living, separated by a privacy partition.

facts.text: Rooms have a dedicated makeup vanity and dressing area with an over-sized mirror and flattering lights.
facts.excerpt: take a seat at our dedicated makeup vanity and dressing area. Fitted with an over-sized mirror and flattering lights

facts.text: Rooms have SMEG fridges stocked at street prices.
facts.excerpt: Our signature SMEG fridges are smartly stocked at street prices, so you won't be paying a premium for the convenience.

facts.text: Suites include a communal space for work and play with separate chambers.
facts.excerpt: Our luxury Nashville suites include a communal space for you to work and play, complete with separate chambers

facts.text: The Pool Club is a rooftop pool on the 14th floor with cabanas, loungers and skyline views.
facts.excerpt: enjoy canapés in your cabana or take a lazy lunch in a lounger at our 14th floor rooftop pool in downtown Nashville. Of course, we didn't forget the chill beats and skyline views to match.

facts.text: The Late Great is a speakeasy inspired by the spirit of Nashville's B-Room studios, with rare whiskeys and live sets.
facts.excerpt: Channeling the spirit of Nashville’s iconic B-Room studios—intimate, untouchable, and effortlessly cool. Come for the rare whiskeys, stay for the live sets and low-lit magic.

facts.text: At Commons Club, Chef Adam Terhune serves reinvented American classics with southern twists.
facts.excerpt: Join Chef Adam Terhune at the Commons Club in Nashville as he serves up reinvented American classics with unexpected southern twists.

facts.text: Funny Library is a coffee shop and communal workspace serving La Colombe coffee.
facts.excerpt: Our whimsical coffee shop and communal workspace is where the line between work and play fades away. Refuel with caffeinated brews by La Colombe

facts.text: Pets stay free, with no size or breed restrictions.
facts.excerpt: pets stay free. No size or breed restrictions!

facts.text: The Virgin Hotels App lets guests order room service, adjust temperature, control lights and TV, and access their room.
facts.excerpt: Order room service, adjust the temperature, control the lights and TV or access your chamber.

facts.text: The hotel runs a line-up of live entertainment and programming.
facts.excerpt: our line-up of live entertainment and programming at Virgin Hotels Nashville

facts.text: The gym and fitness center is on the second floor.
facts.excerpt: Walk, jog or run up to our gym and fitness center on the second floor.

facts.text: The hotel has spaces for meetings, events and weddings.
facts.excerpt: Whether you’re looking to celebrate your happily ever after, deliver a top-notch client presentation, or have a meeting of the minds, we have a space for you.

facts.text: The hotel calls its beds so comfortable you'll think you're dreaming.
facts.excerpt: beds are so comfortable, rooms are so spacious and added extras are so extra that you’ll think you’re dreaming
